name: vscode-tulcase
description: A native VS Code productivity suite — TODOs, time records, bookmarks, commands, lists, and tags — all inside your editor.

tulcase.dataDirectory.description: Path to the Tulcase data directory. Leave empty to use the default (~/.tulcase).

tulcase.sync.repoUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the git repository used to sync Tulcase data (e.g. https://github.com/user/tulcase-data.git).

tulcase.sync.autoSync.description: Automatically pull on activation and push after data changes.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_list_todos
languageModelTools.userDescription: List your Tulcase TODOs with optional filters (all, open, done, overdue, today) and tag filtering.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List Tulcase TODO items. Supports filtering by status (all/open/done/overdue/today) and by tag name. Returns an array of todo items with id, note, date, done, and tags fields.

filter.description: Filter todos by status. Default: all.

tag.description: Filter todos to only those with this tag.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_add_todo
languageModelTools.userDescription: Add a new TODO to Tulcase.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new Tulcase TODO item. Requires a note (text). Optionally set a date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today) and tags (array of tag names).

date.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_update_todo
languageModelTools.userDescription: Update an existing Tulcase TODO (mark done, change text, date, or tags).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Update a Tulcase TODO item by ID. Can change done status, note text, date, or tags. Use tulcase_list_todos first to get valid IDs.

done.description: Mark as done or not done.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_delete_todo
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delete a Tulcase TODO by ID.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Permanently delete a Tulcase TODO item by its ID. Use tulcase_list_todos first to get valid IDs.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_list_notes
languageModelTools.userDescription: List all Tulcase notes and folders, with optional tag filtering.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all Tulcase notes and their folder structure. Optionally filter by tag. Returns notes (id, label, content, tags, folder, createdAt, updatedAt) and folders (id, name, parent).

tag.description: Filter notes to only those with this tag.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_read_note
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the full content of a Tulcase note by ID.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the full content and metadata of a Tulcase note by its ID. Use tulcase_list_notes first to find valid IDs.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_add_note
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new Tulcase note.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new Tulcase note. Requires a label. Optionally set content (markdown text), tags, and folder ID. Use tulcase_list_notes to see available folders.

folder.description: Folder ID to place the note in. Empty string or omit for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_edit_note
languageModelTools.userDescription: Edit an existing Tulcase note (label, content, tags, or folder).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edit a Tulcase note by ID. Can change label, content, tags, or folder. Use tulcase_list_notes first to get valid IDs.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_manage_note_folder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create, rename, or delete note folders in Tulcase.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage Tulcase note folders. Action create makes a folder optionally under parentId. Action rename changes a folder name by id. Action delete removes a folder by id and moves its direct child notes and direct subfolders to root.

id.description: Existing folder ID. Required for rename and delete.

name.description: Folder name. Required for create and rename.

parentId.description: Parent folder ID for create. Omit or empty for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_move_note_entry
languageModelTools.userDescription: Move a note or note folder into another folder or back to root.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move a Tulcase note entry by id. The id may belong to either a note or a folder. targetFolderId selects the destination folder. Omit targetFolderId or use an empty string to move the entry to root.

id.description: The note or folder ID to move.

targetFolderId.description: Destination folder ID. Omit or empty for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_list_links
languageModelTools.userDescription: List all Tulcase bookmarks/links as a tree, with optional tag filtering.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the Tulcase link tree. Each node has id, type (link/folder), label, url (for links), tags, and children (for folders). Optionally filter by tag.

tag.description: Filter links to only those with this tag.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_add_link
languageModelTools.userDescription: Add a new bookmark/link to Tulcase.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new Tulcase link (bookmark). Requires label and url. Optionally set tags and parentFolderId to place it inside a folder. Use tulcase_list_links to see folder IDs.

parentFolderId.description: Folder ID to place the link in. Omit for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_edit_link
languageModelTools.userDescription: Edit an existing Tulcase link (label, url, or tags).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edit a Tulcase link by ID. Can change label, url, or tags. Use tulcase_list_links first to get valid IDs.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_manage_link_folder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create, rename, or delete bookmark folders in Tulcase.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage Tulcase link folders. Action create makes a folder optionally under parentFolderId. Action rename changes a folder label by id. Action delete removes a folder by id and deletes its entire nested subtree.

id.description: Existing folder ID. Required for rename and delete.

name.description: Folder name. Required for create and rename.

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder ID for create. Omit or empty for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_move_link_entry
languageModelTools.userDescription: Move a link or link folder into another folder or back to root.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move a Tulcase link entry by id. The id may belong to either a link or a folder. targetFolderId selects the destination folder. Omit targetFolderId or use an empty string to move the entry to root.

id.description: The link or folder ID to move.

targetFolderId.description: Destination folder ID. Omit or empty for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_list_commands
languageModelTools.userDescription: List all Tulcase saved commands/snippets, with optional tag filtering.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List Tulcase saved commands (shell snippets). Returns commands (id, label, command text, tags, folder) and folders. Optionally filter by tag.

tag.description: Filter commands to only those with this tag.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_add_command
languageModelTools.userDescription: Save a new command/snippet to Tulcase.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new Tulcase saved command. Requires label and command text. Optionally set tags and folder ID.

command.description: The shell command or snippet text.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_edit_command
languageModelTools.userDescription: Edit an existing Tulcase command (label, command text, or tags).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edit a Tulcase saved command by ID. Can change label, command text, or tags. Use tulcase_list_commands first to get valid IDs.

folder.description: Move to this folder ID. Use an empty string for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_manage_command_folder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create, rename, or delete command folders in Tulcase.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage Tulcase command folders. Action create makes a folder optionally under parentId. Action rename changes a folder name by id. Action delete removes a folder by id and reparents its direct child commands and direct subfolders to the deleted folder's parent.

id.description: Existing folder ID. Required for rename and delete.

name.description: Folder name. Required for create and rename.

parentId.description: Parent folder ID for create. Omit or empty for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_move_command_entry
languageModelTools.userDescription: Move a command or command folder into another folder or back to root.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move a Tulcase command entry by id. The id may belong to either a command or a folder. targetFolderId selects the destination folder. Omit targetFolderId or use an empty string to move the entry to root.

id.description: The command or folder ID to move.

targetFolderId.description: Destination folder ID. Omit or empty for root.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_list_tags
languageModelTools.userDescription: List all Tulcase tags with their colors and categories.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all defined Tulcase tags. Returns tag name, hex color, and category for each tag.

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_add_tag
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new Tulcase tag with optional color and category.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new Tulcase tag. Requires a name. Optionally set a hex color (default: #8b8fa3) and category (default: general).

languageModelTools.name: tulcase_manage_tag
languageModelTools.userDescription: Rename, recolor, recategorize, or delete a Tulcase tag.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage a Tulcase tag: rename it, change its color, change its category, or delete it. Deletion also removes the tag from all items. Use tulcase_list_tags to see existing tags.

action.description: What to do with the tag.

newValue.description: New name (rename), hex color (recolor), or category (recategorize). Not needed for delete.
